headline.zh-CN: 更轻盈的交互与稳定的阅读位置

summary.zh-CN: 统一界面动效，改善弹窗焦点与母带沟通阅读体验，并适配系统减弱动效设置。
summary.en: Consistent interface motion, improved dialog focus and mastering chat reading, with support for reduced motion preferences.

title.zh-CN: 轻触反馈与一致的面板过渡
title.en: Light press feedback and consistent panel transitions

description.zh-CN: 按钮、菜单、侧栏与弹窗使用统一的轻量动效。减弱动效模式保留清晰的静态反馈，音频标记与播放定位保持即时响应。
description.en: Buttons, menus, sidebars and dialogs share lightweight motion. Reduced motion preserves clear static feedback, while audio markers and playback positioning remain immediate.

title.zh-CN: 稳定的弹窗内容与焦点

description.zh-CN: 关闭确认框时保留完整退场内容，快速重开与切换目标时保持正确焦点，并隔离旧会话请求结果。
description.en: Confirmation content remains intact during dismissal. Rapid reopening and target changes preserve focus and isolate results from older dialog sessions.

title.zh-CN: 母带沟通保留阅读位置
title.en: Keep your place in mastering chat

description.zh-CN: 浏览历史消息时，收到新消息、切换全屏与重新打开面板会保留阅读位置；新增查看最新消息及未读数量提示。发送失败保留草稿，成功发送后跟随最新消息。
description.en: While reading history, incoming messages, fullscreen changes and reopening preserve your place. A latest-message shortcut shows unread counts. Failed sends retain drafts; successful sends follow the latest message.
